products.name: HireVue
products.note: Video interviewing AI; facial analysis controversy; algorithmic hiring bias; regulatory scrutiny

profile_text.body:
HireVue is a for-profit company founded in 2004 and headquartered in South Jordan, Utah. The company describes itself as a provider of AI-powered video interviewing, skills assessments, and candidate evaluation tools, with a stated focus on helping employers validate candidate skills and competencies without requiring in-person campus visits.

HireVue's primary product is its AI-driven hiring platform, which combines video interviewing with automated assessments. The platform has attracted regulatory scrutiny and controversy over its use of facial analysis and concerns about algorithmic hiring bias, as noted in the site's product records.

The company is a defendant in Rodrigues v. HireVue, Inc., a case filed in the District Court for the Western District of Missouri. HireVue also carries a notable concentration of legal exposure in Utah, where 59 relevant legal matters have been logged.
